case.title: MT New Diamond Fire & Bunker Discharge (Bay of Bengal)

metadata.spill_substance: IFO-380 Heavy Fuel Oil & Engine Bilge
metadata.ocean_model: CMEMS Global Ocean Physics Analysis & Forecast

supporting_evidence.title: Open-Sea Deceleration / Loitering Anomaly
supporting_evidence.description: Vessel exhibited an abnormal open-ocean deceleration from 14.2 knots down to 0.4 knots during passage through the spill area.
supporting_evidence.threshold_used: Speed Drop >= 3.5 kts AND Min Speed < 9.0 kts

supporting_evidence.title: Regional AIS Transmission Outage (5.1h)
supporting_evidence.description: Vessel exhibited a 5.1-hour transponder transmission outage in the regional area.

supporting_evidence.title: High-Risk Laden Crude / Product Tanker Profile
supporting_evidence.description: Vessel is an oil/chemical tanker carrying high-volume liquid hydrocarbon cargo and oily ballast.

contradicting_evidence.title: Slight Temporal Offset (2.3h from Peak)
contradicting_evidence.description: Vessel transit (01:05 UTC) was offset by 2.3 hours from the peak discharge probability time.

exculpatory_evidence.title: Significant Distance from Spill Origin (51.8 km)
exculpatory_evidence.description: Vessel remained 51.8 km away from the estimated origin region, exceeding reasonable oil drift dispersion boundaries.
exculpatory_evidence.calculation_reference: Geodesic Haversine Distance to Origin Centroid

data_quality_items.title: AIS Trajectory Telemetry Density
data_quality_items.description: Trajectory reconstructed from 9 georeferenced AIS positions with geodesic waypoint interpolation at 15-minute resolution.

uncertainty_items.title: Origin Spatial Dispersion Uncertainty (1-Sigma)
uncertainty_items.description: Turbulent diffusion and hydrodynamic divergence define an origin uncertainty radius of +/- 0.50 km around the reconstructed centroid.

uncertainty_items.title: Release Time Uncertainty Window
uncertainty_items.description: Estimated discharge time window is bounded within 4.0 hours with a 90% confidence interval.
